# arin_irr_rpsl (Data Source)

Read an advanced ARIN IRR object using RPSL. Supports route, route6, as-set, route-set and aut-num objects created through the RPSL interface. ARIN rejects this format for simple XML-created objects; use the corresponding typed data source for those. The complete RPSL text is returned without discarding attributes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The object must have been created using RPSL, not the XML interface.
data "arin_irr_rpsl" "example" {
  object_type = "as-set"
  name        = "AS-EXAMPLE"
}

output "advanced_as_set" {
  value = data.arin_irr_rpsl.example.rpsl
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Canonical CIDR for routes, uppercase set name for sets, or AS followed by the ASN for aut-num.
- `object_type` (String) One of route, route6, as-set, route-set or aut-num.

### Optional

- `origin_as` (String) Required for route and route6, for example AS64496. Omit for other types.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object type and name separated by a slash, with a comma and origin ASN appended for routes.
- `org_handle` (String) Maintaining organization derived from the mnt-by attribute.
- `rpsl` (String) Complete returned RPSL object, including attributes not modeled by the typed XML data sources. Line endings are normalized to LF with a trailing newline.
